name: pets-p1
description: Pet program Stage P1: the pets catalog tab is visible in both Simple and Pro when petFittings is on, and hidden when off. The window/balcony mesh screen snaps onto the nearest window (windowBound) and reads as a fine safety mesh; the pet gate + pet-door insert snap across the nearest doorway (NEW doorBound plumbing); a freestanding playpen places normally. Each fitting is committed through the REAL usePlacementController commit path (setActiveDefId + setGhostWorld + a canvas click), and the placed item's position is asserted to sit exactly on the snapped window/door centre.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: set-daytime
steps.eval: window.__store.getState().setManualHour?.(13)

steps.name: assert-pets-tab-simple
steps.eval: (function(){ const chips = [...document.querySelectorAll('.cat-rail .chip')].map(c => c.textContent?.trim() || ''); if (!chips.some(t => t.includes('Pets'))) throw new Error('Pets category chip should be visible in Simple mode (petFittings is simple-tier): ' + JSON.stringify(chips)); })()

steps.name: assert-pets-tab-pro
steps.eval: (function(){ const chips = [...document.querySelectorAll('.cat-rail .chip')].map(c => c.textContent?.trim() || ''); if (!chips.some(t => t.includes('Pets'))) throw new Error('Pets category chip should also be visible in Pro mode: ' + JSON.stringify(chips)); })()

steps.name: open-pets-tab
steps.eval: (function(){ const chip = [...document.querySelectorAll('.cat-rail .chip')].find(c => (c.textContent||'').includes('Pets')); if (chip) chip.click(); })()

steps.name: drop-near-window
steps.eval: (function(){ const st = window.__store.getState(); const fp = st.floorPlan; const byId = Object.fromEntries(fp.walls.map(w => [w.id, w])); const centre = (o) => { const w = byId[o.wallId]; const dx = w.end[0]-w.start[0], dz = w.end[1]-w.start[1]; const len = Math.hypot(dx,dz); const t = o.offset + o.width/2; return { id:o.id, cx: w.start[0]+dx/len*t, cz: w.start[1]+dz/len*t, nx:-dz/len, nz:dx/len, width:o.width, sill:o.sill, head:o.head }; }; const win = fp.openings.filter(o => o.kind==='window' && byId[o.wallId]).map(centre)[0]; if (!win) throw new Error('plan has no window opening'); window.__win = win; window.__store.getState().setGhostWorld([win.cx + win.nx*0.3, win.cz + win.nz*0.3], true); })()

steps.name: click-commit-mesh
steps.eval: (function(){ const c = document.querySelector('canvas'); if (!c) throw new Error('no canvas'); c.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, button: 0 })); })()

steps.name: mesh-committed
steps.failMessage: The window mesh screen should commit (windowBound snap) and disarm

steps.name: assert-mesh-on-window
steps.eval: (function(){ const st = window.__store.getState(); const it = st.items.find(i => i.defId === 'window-mesh-screen'); const d = Math.hypot(it.position[0]-window.__win.cx, it.position[1]-window.__win.cz); if (d > 0.001) throw new Error('mesh screen is ' + d.toFixed(3) + 'm from the window centre — not snapped'); const clamp=(v,lo,hi)=>Math.min(hi,Math.max(lo,v)); const expW = clamp(window.__win.width + 0.06, 0.4, 3.4); if (Math.abs(it.props.width - expW) > 1e-6) throw new Error('mesh width ' + it.props.width + ' != expected ' + expW); console.log('mesh screen snapped to window ' + window.__win.id + ' d=' + d.toFixed(4)); })()

steps.name: focus-window
steps.eval: window.__store.getState().requestFrameSelection?.({center:[window.__win.cx,(window.__win.sill+window.__win.head)/2,window.__win.cz],radius:1.3})

steps.name: deselect-before-03-mesh-screen-on-window
steps.eval: window.__store.getState().selectItem?.(null)

steps.name: drop-near-door
steps.eval: (function(){ const st = window.__store.getState(); const fp = st.floorPlan; const byId = Object.fromEntries(fp.walls.map(w => [w.id, w])); const centre = (o) => { const w = byId[o.wallId]; const dx = w.end[0]-w.start[0], dz = w.end[1]-w.start[1]; const len = Math.hypot(dx,dz); const t = o.offset + o.width/2; return { id:o.id, cx: w.start[0]+dx/len*t, cz: w.start[1]+dz/len*t, nx:-dz/len, nz:dx/len, width:o.width }; }; const door = fp.openings.filter(o => o.kind==='door' && byId[o.wallId]).map(centre)[0]; if (!door) throw new Error('plan has no door opening'); window.__door = door; window.__store.getState().setGhostWorld([door.cx + door.nx*0.3, door.cz + door.nz*0.3], true); })()

steps.name: click-commit-gate
steps.eval: (function(){ const c = document.querySelector('canvas'); c.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, button: 0 })); })()

steps.name: gate-committed
steps.failMessage: The pet gate should commit (doorBound snap) and disarm

steps.name: assert-gate-on-door
steps.eval: (function(){ const st = window.__store.getState(); const it = st.items.find(i => i.defId === 'pet-gate'); const d = Math.hypot(it.position[0]-window.__door.cx, it.position[1]-window.__door.cz); if (d > 0.001) throw new Error('pet gate is ' + d.toFixed(3) + 'm from the door centre — doorBound snap failed'); const clamp=(v,lo,hi)=>Math.min(hi,Math.max(lo,v)); const expW = clamp(window.__door.width, 0.6, 1.4); if (Math.abs(it.props.width - expW) > 1e-6) throw new Error('gate width ' + it.props.width + ' != expected ' + expW); console.log('pet gate snapped to door ' + window.__door.id + ' d=' + d.toFixed(4)); })()

steps.name: focus-door
steps.eval: window.__store.getState().requestFrameSelection?.({center:[window.__door.cx,0.45,window.__door.cz],radius:1.05})

steps.name: deselect-before-04-pet-gate-spanning-doorway
steps.eval: window.__store.getState().selectItem?.(null)

steps.name: drop-near-door-2
steps.eval: (function(){ const st = window.__store.getState(); const fp = st.floorPlan; const byId = Object.fromEntries(fp.walls.map(w => [w.id, w])); const centre = (o) => { const w = byId[o.wallId]; const dx = w.end[0]-w.start[0], dz = w.end[1]-w.start[1]; const len = Math.hypot(dx,dz); const t = o.offset + o.width/2; return { id:o.id, cx: w.start[0]+dx/len*t, cz: w.start[1]+dz/len*t, nx:-dz/len, nz:dx/len }; }; const doors = fp.openings.filter(o => o.kind==='door' && byId[o.wallId]).map(centre); const door = doors[1] || doors[0]; window.__door2 = door; window.__store.getState().setGhostWorld([door.cx + door.nx*0.3, door.cz + door.nz*0.3], true); })()

steps.name: click-commit-petdoor
steps.eval: (function(){ const c = document.querySelector('canvas'); c.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, button: 0 })); })()

steps.name: petdoor-committed
steps.failMessage: The pet-door insert should commit (doorBound snap)

steps.name: focus-door2
steps.eval: window.__store.getState().requestFrameSelection?.({center:[window.__door2.cx,0.45,window.__door2.cz],radius:0.95})

steps.name: deselect-before-05-pet-door-insert
steps.eval: window.__store.getState().selectItem?.(null)

steps.name: drop-playpen-open-floor
steps.eval: (function(){ const w = window.__win; const c = [w.cx + w.nx * 1.2, w.cz + w.nz * 1.2]; window.__pen = c; window.__store.getState().setGhostWorld([c[0], c[1]], true); })()

steps.name: click-commit-playpen
steps.eval: (function(){ const c = document.querySelector('canvas'); c.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, button: 0 })); })()

steps.name: confirm-playpen

steps.name: focus-playpen
steps.eval: window.__store.getState().requestFrameSelection?.({center:[window.__pen[0],0.4,window.__pen[1]],radius:1.25})

steps.name: flag-off

steps.name: assert-pets-tab-hidden
steps.eval: (function(){ const chips = [...document.querySelectorAll('.cat-rail .chip')].map(c => c.textContent?.trim() || ''); if (chips.some(t => t.includes('Pets'))) throw new Error('Pets chip should be HIDDEN when petFittings is off: ' + JSON.stringify(chips)); const counts = window.__store.getState(); console.log('pets tab hidden with flag off'); })()

steps.name: flag-on-restore
